name: weichseltree
notes: Machine-readable design tokens for weichseltree: the site, the grove's HUD, the flat dashboard, thumbnails and titles.

Colour has two sources. `world` is the ruled gallery palette of the hall (DECISIONS 2026-09-12; grove/tools/bake_hall.py PALETTES['gallery']; recorded in grove/public/assets/hall/hall.json geometry.albedo_linear). Those are linear-RGB albedos of materials under baked light, not screen colours; the sRGB hex beside each is the same albedo encoded for a screen, for reference only. `ui` is what the shipped pages use today (grove/index.html, grove/src/ui/grove.css, grove/src/config.ts PALETTE, grove/public/privacy/index.html).
LAWS 12: greys by default, hue reserved for meaning. LAWS 13: dark theme everywhere. There is no light theme and none is planned.
The accent (#7fc97f) is the only hue in the chrome. It marks: the way in, the host, playing, the seed. Nothing else.

box-room.$description: default colour of an unbaked grey box room (grove/src/world/schema.ts)

ground.$description: the placeholder for the orchard grounds

body.$description: long-form body text on the privacy page

dim.$description: secondary text, labels, the link state; grove.css --dim

faint.$description: device hints on the holding page

accent.$description: the one hue: enter, host, playing, the seed; grove.css --accent

bad.$description: a failed link or a failure notice; the only other hue, and only for failure

accent-underline.$description: dotted underline under the 'N here' button

video.$description: For titles, thumbnails and inserts (LAWS 7, 12, 13): black ground, the same greys, the accent for the seed only. Particle hues come from the tape header's species palette, never from here.

ui.$description: No web fonts: font-src is 'self' and nothing is self-hosted. Google Fonts is out (HOSTING.md: no Google endpoints in the client).

mono.$description: numbers in the perf panel, hashes, commands

small.$description: notices, the time readout, small buttons

tiny.$description: perf panel, provenance pre, section labels

h1-site.$description: compact page title; the landing hero uses h1-landing

h1-landing.$description: responsive landing hero heading in grove/index.html, adjusted for small screens

strong.$description: the only bold. 700 is never used.

label.$description: with text-transform: uppercase and color dim

numbers.$description: every readout that changes while you watch

wordmark.case: lower, always, including at the start of a sentence
wordmark.mark: a 0.6rem accent disc with a 12px accent glow before the word: the seed (.seed in grove/index.html). It is the only mark. There is no logo file.

space.$description: Pixels, as the CSS uses them. Multiples of 2, mostly of 6 or 8.

measure.$description: body copy measure; 40rem on the privacy page; the landing page composes columns within a 1160px layout

no-shadows.$value: Panels have no drop shadow. Depth comes from the world, not the chrome.

motion.$description: The chrome is still. Nothing on the world animates for its own sake (LAWS 7). Durations below are the ones the code uses plus two proposed ones; prefers-reduced-motion turns the proposed ones off.

notice-life.$description: a notice stays 9 s unless sticky; at most 4 on screen (hud.ts)

hover.$description: today: no transition on hover; the border and text turn accent at once

panel-reveal.$description: opacity only, for the people and provenance panels

teleport-fade.$description: to black and back on a portal crossing; never a swoop (comfort in VR)

tape-speeds.$value: the SPEEDS list in grove/src/tape/time.ts; the scrubber's select shows them as Nx

sound.$description: Cue names for the grove and the channel. None of these files exist yet; this is the list to produce once, in one session, in one voice (LAWS 19). Format: Opus, mono, 48 kHz, peak -3 dBFS, integrated around -20 LUFS so a cue never jumps over voice. Every cue is short and dry: no reverb baked in, the room does that. The client must never play a cue the visitor did not cause, except `error`.

enter.when: the world connected and the visitor is standing in the hall
enter.character: one soft low note, like a door settling

portal.character: a short breath of air, no pitch

someone.when: another person joins your room; never for yourself, never for leaving

chat.when: a chat line arrives while the people panel is closed

error.when: a sticky failure notice (link lost, media 404)
error.character: one dull knock, low, -6 dB below the others

unmute.when: the visitor's own microphone opens (push-to-talk down)
unmute.character: a click; heard by the speaker only

scrub.when: never; the tape is silent while scrubbed

channel.when: the first frame of every episode, on the seed
channel.character: a single sustained low tone with one overtone rising; the same file for every episode, never re-recorded

voice.narration: one delivery voice for the channel, chosen by audition (LAWS 19); ElevenLabs, ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID names it
voice.music: one bed per episode with ducking under narration (LAWS 18); nothing in the grove itself

hero-still.wanted: one 3840x2160 still of the current hall with exhibits loaded, from a real browser at the live site, AVIF plus JPEG; distinct from the source poster and architectural render now on the landing page

clip-20s.wanted: a 20 s cut from einstruct's ab_d2 clip (bundle 216b720501856b14, 40 s) or a screen capture of walking into the sheet; H.264 mp4 under 8 MB for GitHub, and the same as a GIF-free <video> on the site

palette-previews.note: the four previews Manuel ruled on; gallery is the one

landing-tape-poster.note: Unchanged poster from einstruct bundle 2dd0038799b2db15, frame 400 of the sampled vr-high variant; also the Open Graph and Twitter share image. Source and sha256 in grove/public/site/imagery.json.

landing-hall-render.note: Lossless encoding of docs/img/palace-still-hall.png with identical decoded pixels verified in site/imagery.json. Explicitly captioned as an architectural render, not a browser screenshot. Lazy loaded.

favicon.note: The seed: a #7fc97f disc on #0e1310; SVG now ships.
